    Age 4 — Dragon Tyranny

    The Twelve Dragon Clans¶

    Dragon society was organized into twelve great clans, each ruling a territory:

    • Xi — the most powerful clan, dominating eastern Erisdar.
    • Klobiendar — western Erisdar, rivals to Xi.
    • Dragomorph — the Lumina Continent, jungle-tamers.
    • Soroben — the Demon Continent, hardened by the black lands.
    • Eight other clans, each with their own domains and rivalries.

    Between them, they commanded 90% of Ge'or. Nothing moved without a dragon's permission.

    The Death Wars¶

    The twelve clans did not coexist. They fought death wars — conflicts of total annihilation where the goal was not conquest but extinction. Armies of hundreds of thousands — dragons, enslaved soldiers, conscripted species — clashed across continents. Dragons themselves took to the skies, raining fire on each other's territories.

    The wars destroyed vast areas of every continent: - Forests burned for decades. - Mountains were shattered by draconic combat. - Civilizations that had taken millennia to build were erased in hours.

    The dragons were exceptional at building empires. They were even better at destroying them.

    The Retreat¶

    By the end of Age 4, the dragon population had collapsed. The death wars had killed most of them. Those who survived looked at the ashes of their civilization and repented.

    The surviving dragons withdrew from the world. They abandoned empire-building and adopted a contemplative, ascetic lifestyle — the seeds of the honor-based culture that would eventually flourish in Kramsadar.

    Some dragons were not born into civilized clans. These became wild dragons — hostile, territorial, uncivilized. They guard treasures in remote lairs, secluding themselves in mountains and caves. They are the dragons of legend: beasts to be hunted, monsters to be feared.

    The civilized dragons — the descendants of the clans who repented — are nearly extinct. Kramsadar on Marti Continent is their last sanctuary.

    The Lost History¶

    The Dragon Tyranny's greatest casualty was history itself. The death wars destroyed most records from Age 3 and earlier. What little survived the crash of the Glorious Alliance was burned in dragon fire. The early history of every species was reduced to oral tradition and fragments.
